items.item_text: Two (2) years of recent experience as aWorker's Compensation Case Manager ina healthcare setting
Is a role model for the Hospital's Patient Satisfaction effort, i.e. demonstrates AIDET principles when interacting with customers, subordinates and colleagues.
This position provides coordination, planning, development, evaluation and monitoring of SBMC Workers Compensation, and Transitional Duty or Return to Work program.

Specifically, uses a problem solving process that includes assessment, problem identification, goal definition, plan development, evaluation and revision of the plan to achieve optimum employee outcomes for work related injuries, including return to work outcomes.
Works with injured employees, the third party Workers' Compensation administrator for the self-insured trust, providers of medical services including physicians, and designates of the employer.
Acts as liaison between employee, management, and Workers Compensation administrators.
Manages progress of claims with Workers Compensation administrator, Employee Health, physicians, and SBMC management; communicating frequently with all to expedite the claim process.
Knowledge of treatment modalities for workers comp related injuries
Knowledge of California Workers Comp regulations/OSHA regulations
Ability to work effectively with other clinical professionals and the Medical Staff
